author: grok-4.7-medium-fast
why_hard: A bare Exception handler, a Deny whose principal is a star, invoice-number literals, a digest_limit default of 0, and a deleted idle write all look suspicious, but the exception is re-raised after the metric, the star applies only to the bounce resource, the literals are the subjects the test enqueued, zero is rejected before use, and the idle timestamp was never read.
